blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.
blocks.zh: 世界模型将视觉表现转化为预测和行动. 我们主张他们的视觉基础应该结合物理状态信息,本土语言相接,和像素重建,这样一个单一的表述可以支持预测,指示和检查. 然而,现有的编码器一般只专门使用一到两种这种能力;因此我们引入了ALPS,一种预先训练的视觉状态编码器,将所有三种编码统一在一整套补丁符号中. 我们只使用静态的图像和文字,从零开始从语言,重建,空间对应目标中预演一个VIT-B/16,然后通过交叉视图自沉来完善. 在对15个公共编码器的统一评价中,ALPS在VIT-B模型中实现了LIBERO状态-探测最小的差错(匹配3.5x更大的V-JEPA 2-L),同时保持了强大的语言对接和准确的像素重建. 下游被冻结的ALPS标志在LIBERO(85.5%)上达到了最高的中间政策成功度, 与我们本土的文本塔对齐, 匹配或超过世界模型规划的主要编码器, 跨越PushT, Wall, 和 Granular, 并允许预测的未来标志被直接解码为像素, 用于视觉检查. 我们希望这项工作有助于建立视觉预训,作为世界模型中理解、预测和行动的共同基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World models predict how a scene changes in response to actions and use these predictions to plan.
Many of them operate in the latent space of a frozen pretrained visual encoder [ 91 , 6 , 4 ] .
The encoder therefore decides what the world model can see: only when its tokens encode where objects are and what state they are in can a downstream world model learn how that state changes from scarce interaction data.
Two complementary interfaces make such an encoder far more versatile.
With tokens aligned to language, instructions and goals stated in words can be related to the scene without a second visual encoder.
With tokens that decode back into images, both observed scenes and imagined futures can be rendered and inspected.
This raises a central question: how can we pretrain a single visual encoder that provides physical-state information, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction at once?
blocks.zh:
世界模型预测一个场景如何因行动而变化,并利用这些预测来进行规划.
其中许多在冷冻的预先训练的视觉编码器的潜伏空间运作[91, 6, 4].
因此,编码器决定了世界模型能够看到什么:只有当其符号编码了物体在哪里以及它们处于何种状态时,下游世界模型才能从稀缺的相互作用数据中得知该状态是如何变化的.
两个互补接口使这种编码器更具有多功能性。
与语言对齐的符号,以文字表述的指令和目标可以在没有第二个视觉编码器的情况下与场景相关.
有了重新解码成图像的标志,可以渲染和检查所观察到的场景和想象的未来.
这提出了一个中心问题:我们怎样才能先训练一个单一的视觉编码器,即时提供物理状态信息,语言对齐,以及像素重建?

blocks.en:
Existing public encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities.
Self-supervised and agglomerative models such as DINOv2, DINOv3, and C-RADIOv3 provide transferable spatial features [ 53 , 66 , 30 ] , while predictive video encoders such as V-JEPA 2 learn spatiotemporal representations through latent prediction [ 4 ] .
Meanwhile, image-text encoders such as CLIP, SigLIP 2, and PE-Core align vision with language [ 61 , 69 , 7 ] , and reconstruction-based encoders preserve fine visual detail in pixels or latents [ 29 , 86 ] .
Combining state information, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction in a single representation is not straightforward.
A refinement that improves the state information of an image-text encoder, for example, can substantially degrade its language alignment, as we show for SigLIP 2 and CLIP ( Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
现有的公共编码器一般只专门使用其中的一种或两种能力.
自行监管和凝聚模型如DINOv2,DINOv3和C-RADIOv3提供了可转移的空间特征[53,66,30],而V-JEPA2等预测视频编码器则通过潜伏的预测来学习瞬间表达[4].
同时,图像文本编码器如CLIP,SigLIP 2和PE-Core将视觉与语言[61,69,7]对齐,基于重建的编码器在像素或潜伏中保存精细的视觉细节[29,86].
将状态信息,语言对齐,和像素重建合并在一个单一的表示中并不简单.
例如,通过改进图像文本编码器的状态信息,可以大幅降低其语言的校正性,正如我们对SigLIP 2和CLIP(第5.2节)所表明的那样。

blocks.en:
To resolve this tension, we pretrain our encoder in two stages ( Fig. 2 ).
The first stage establishes language alignment, pixel reconstruction, and spatial features in a shared representation.
We train a ViT-B/16 from scratch on image-text pairs with contrastive alignment, captioning, reconstruction, and dense correspondence objectives on the same patch tokens.
The second stage then strengthens state information through cross-view self-distillation, training the encoder to predict scene content across changes in crop, scale, and appearance.
From an augmented view, the student predicts a frozen first-stage teacher’s patch tokens at corresponding locations in a clean view.
Both stages train on still images and text alone, without video or interaction supervision.
We call the final encoder ALPS ( A L anguage-aligned, P ixel-renderable S tate encoder) and the intermediate encoder after the first stage ALPS (Stage 1).

blocks.en:
We compare ALPS with fifteen public encoders, all frozen and evaluated under common protocols ( , Tab. 1 ).
ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B encoders, matching the 3.5 × 3.5\times larger V-JEPA 2-L, while retaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction.
Cross-view refinement reduces state-probe error by 17% while changing image-text retrieval by at most 0.5 points, and also improves world-model prediction.
In contrast, the same refinement lowers ImageNet zero-shot accuracy and image-to-text retrieval by 4–12 points for SigLIP 2 and CLIP ( Fig. 5 ).
Frozen ALPS tokens achieve the highest mean policy success in our LIBERO comparison when paired with our native text tower, and support leading planning performance on PushT, Wall, and Granular ( Sec. 5.3 ).
Predicted future tokens can also be decoded into images for inspection.
blocks.zh:
我们把ALPS与15个公共编码器进行比较,这些编码器都是根据共同协议冻结和评估的(图1)。
ALPS在ViT-B编码器中实现最小的聚合LIBERO状态-探测错误,匹配3.5×3.5\times更大的V-JEPA2-L,同时保留强大的语言对齐和准确的像素重建.
交叉视图的改进在改变图像文本检索最多0.5点的同时,将状态-概率误差减少17%,同时也改善了世界模型预测.
与此相反,同样的改进降低了SigLIP 2和CLIP(图5)的ImageNet零射精度和图像对文本检索4–12分.

预示的未来令牌也可以解码成图像以供检查.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We formulate visual state pretraining for world models and establish a unified evaluation protocol spanning physical-state information, native language alignment, pixel reconstruction, and downstream control, planning, and prediction. • We introduce ALPS, pretrained from scratch on still images and text with joint language, reconstruction, and spatial objectives followed by cross-view self-distillation. • We demonstrate that one frozen representation can combine competitive performance across all three capabilities and serve as a shared visual foundation for robot policies and world models.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们为世界模型制定视觉状态预训,并建立一个涵盖物理状态信息、当地语言协调、像素重建、下游控制、规划和预测的统一评价协议。 我们引入了ALPS,从头开始在静态图像和文本上进行预训,并使用联合语言、重建和空间目标,然后进行交叉视图自我消化。 我们表明,一种冻结的代表权可以将所有三种能力的竞争性表现结合起来,并作为机器人政策和世界模式的共同视觉基础。

blocks.en:
Contrastive image-text pretraining connects visual representations to language [ 61 , 84 ] .
Subsequent approaches incorporate captioning supervision [ 82 , 40 , 44 ] , self-distillation and masked prediction [ 69 ] , spatial objectives [ 49 , 12 ] , image reconstruction [ 67 ] , or autoregressive patch prediction [ 23 ] .
Meanwhile, unified tokenizers and multimodal models couple understanding with generation [ 46 , 89 , 76 ] .
Other work instead adapts a frozen self-supervised backbone to language, as in dino.txt [ 32 ] , or encodes the latents of a generative autoencoder, as in OpenVision 3 [ 86 ] .
Instead of adapting a frozen backbone or encoding autoencoder latents, our first stage jointly trains unnormalized patch tokens for language alignment, pixel reconstruction, and dense correspondence, providing a unified initialization for stage-two cross-view refinement.
blocks.zh:
矛盾的图像文本预训将视觉表现与语言连接[61,84].
随后的办法包括标题监督[82、40、44]、自我沉淀和蒙面预测[69]、空间目标[49、12]、图像重建[67]或自递补丁预测[23]。
同时,统一的标致器和多式联运模型与一代人[46、89、76]具有共同的理解。
其他工作则将冷冻的自我监督骨干适应语言,如dino.txt [32],或编码基因自编码器的潜伏,如OpenVision 3 [86].
我们的第一阶段不是调整一个冷冻的骨干或编码自动编码器潜伏,而是联合培训非正常的补丁符号,用于语言对齐,像素重建,以及密集的通信,为第二阶段交叉视图的改进提供了统一的初始化.

blocks.en:
Self-distillation [ 13 , 92 , 53 , 66 ] , latent prediction [ 3 , 18 ] , and multi-teacher distillation [ 63 , 30 ] learn transferable patch representations.
To further strengthen dense spatial features, recent methods align region features with crop embeddings [ 75 ] , match patch-neighborhood orderings across views [ 55 ] , enforce locality alignment [ 17 ] , apply spatial refinement as in Perception Encoder [ 7 ] , or supervise predictions at multiple depths [ 51 ] .
Without relying on external teachers, our second stage refines the encoder from its own frozen first-stage weights through geometry-conditioned cross-view self-distillation, sharpening state information while preserving native language alignment and pixel reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
自我蒸馏[13、92、53、66],潜在预测[3、18],以及多教师蒸馏[63、30] 学习可转移的补丁表示。
为了进一步加强密集的空间特征,最近的方法使区域特征与作物嵌入[75] 相配合,将补丁-邻接的订单对准视界[55],执行局部对齐[17],适用Pereption Encoder[7]中的空间完善,或监督多深度的预测[51].
我们的第二阶段在不依靠外部教师的情况下,通过几何条件的交叉视图自我消化,在保持本土语言对齐和像素重建的同时,将编码器从自身冷冻的第一阶段重量中提炼出来,使状态信息更加清晰.

blocks.en:
Policies using pretrained visual representations can be competitive with those using ground-truth state inputs [ 54 ] .
Robot representations have been learned from egocentric video [ 52 ] , masked autoencoding [ 62 , 48 ] , language supervision [ 33 ] , foundation-model distillation [ 65 ] , and neural rendering [ 93 ] .
Comparative studies find no single dominant representation [ 48 ] , show that general vision datasets can match egocentric video for visuomotor pretraining [ 19 ] , and note that domain-specific pretraining does not guarantee robustness under visual shifts [ 11 ] .
Pretrained on general-domain images and text, ALPS provides frozen state tokens and a native text tower that transfer directly to language-conditioned manipulation.
blocks.zh:
使用事先经过训练的视觉表现的政策可以与使用地面真实状态投入的政策相竞争[54]。
机器人的表达方式是从以自我为中心的视频[52],蒙面自动编码[62,48],语言监督[33],基础模型蒸馏[65],神经渲染[93]中吸取的.
比较研究发现没有单一的主导代表[48],显示一般视觉数据集可以匹配以自我为中心的视频进行粘着电动机预训[19],并指出特定域的预训并不能保证视觉转变下的稳健性[11].
Pretrained on general-domain images and text, ALPS 提供被冻结的状态标志和一个本土文本塔,直接转入语言条件化的操纵.

blocks.en:
World models can learn a visual autoencoder before fitting latent dynamics [ 27 ] , learn representations jointly with dynamics [ 28 , 47 , 36 ] , or build on pretrained features [ 6 ] .
In particular, DINO-WM plans over frozen DINOv2 tokens [ 91 ] , V-JEPA 2 connects video pretraining to action-conditioned planning [ 4 ] , and frozen features also support language-conditioned planning [ 38 ] , whereas RepWAM learns visual and action tokenizers directly from robot data [ 70 ] .
Generative world models instead simulate observations using learned tokenizers with autoregressive or diffusion dynamics [ 50 , 9 , 1 ] , or via pixel-space diffusion [ 2 ] .
Recent studies further show that off-the-shelf features do not automatically improve sample efficiency in model-based reinforcement learning [ 64 ] , that pixel reconstruction fidelity alone is an unreliable proxy for recovering actions from latent transitions [ 80 ] , and that static image encoders can outperform video encoders depending on downstream protocols [ 68 ] .
We focus on pretraining the visual encoder whose frozen tokens serve as the state representation for downstream world models.
blocks.zh:
世界模型可以先学习视觉自动编码器,然后才能适应潜伏的动态[27],结合动态学习表现[28,47,36],或者利用预先训练过的特征[6].
特别是,DINO-WM计划针对冻结的DINov2令牌[91],V-JEPA2将视频预训与行动条件规划[4],被冻结的特性也支持语言条件规划[38],而RepWAM直接从机器人数据中学习视觉和动作指示器[70].
相反,基因世界模型利用具有自动递归或扩散动力学的有学问的标定器模拟观测[50,9,1],或通过像素空间扩散[2].
最近的研究进一步表明,现成的特性在基于模型的强化学习中并不能自动提高样本效率[64],光是像素重建忠贞性就是一个不可靠的代名词,可以从潜在的过渡中恢复动作[80],静态图像编码器可以根据下游协议来超越视频编码器[68].
我们专注于预先训练视觉编码器, 其冷冻的装饰物是下游世界模型的国家代表。

blocks.en: 3.1 Stage 1: joint pretraining from scratch
blocks.zh: 3.1 第一阶段:从零开始联合预训

blocks.en:
Stage 1 builds a shared representation through complementary language, pixel, and spatial supervision ( Fig. 2 , top).
Contrastive alignment and captioning connect the tokens to language, reconstruction preserves visual detail, and dense correspondence supervises local spatial relationships across views.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段通过互补语言、像素和空间监督(图2,顶端)建立共同代表。
相互矛盾的对齐和标题将符号与语言连接起来,重建保存视觉细节,密集的通信监督各地的空间关系.

blocks.en:
The image encoder E E is a ViT-B/16 [ 22 ] with fixed sine-cosine position embeddings.
It outputs the raw patch tokens z z of the last transformer block without a final normalization layer.
We jointly train a text encoder and a caption decoder with the same width and depth as E E ( Sec. S1 ).
A lightweight convolutional decoder D D maps z z to pixels for the pretraining reconstruction objective, whereas all reported reconstructions use a separate evaluation decoder trained on frozen tokens ( Sec. 4 ).

Contrastive alignment. Each image is paired with its web caption and one sentence from a longer synthetic caption.
We compute an InfoNCE loss [ 61 ] between the mean-pooled, projected image tokens and each caption set, then average the two losses to obtain ℒ itc \mathcal{L}_{\text{itc}} .
Each loss uses its own softmax, so the two captions paired with the same image are never treated as negatives of each other.

blocks.en:
Dense correspondence. This objective directly supervises patch correspondence across crops, scales, and flips.
We form a second view g ⁡ ( x ) g(x) via a random crop and flip of x x , so the location of each patch in the original view is known.
A small projection head maps the tokens of both views to contrastive features.
For each patch of g ⁡ ( x ) g(x) , the positive feature is sampled bilinearly from the projected token field of x x at the corresponding location.
Features at other locations in the same image and from other images serve as negatives in an InfoNCE loss ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} ( Sec. S1 ), encouraging local discriminability.
Following prior work on dense correspondence and pixel-level consistency [ 71 , 77 ] , this term adds explicit cross-view patch supervision to global image-text alignment and single-image reconstruction.

在此前关于密密的函文和像素级一致性[71,77]的工作之后,这个术语为全球图像文本对齐和单像重建增加了明确的交叉视图补丁监督.

blocks.en:
We train on DataComp-1B [ 24 ] using its web captions and synthetic captions generated by the LLaVA-LLaMA-3 captioner from Recap-DataComp-1B [ 39 ] , conditioned on the original web caption [ 44 ] .
Because the captioner uses a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 39 ] , knowledge from this image-text model reaches our encoder only through text; no external visual model supplies feature targets.
Training processes 12.8 billion samples at 128 × 128 128\times 128 resolution, followed by 1.0 billion samples at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution ( Sec. S1 ).
After Stage 1, we retain the image encoder, text encoder, and image projection, while discarding the caption decoder, dense-correspondence projector, and D D .

由于字幕机使用冷冻的CLIP ViT-L/14[39],从这个图像文本模型获得的知识只能通过文本到达我们的编码器;没有外部视觉模型提供特征目标.

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage 2: cross-view self-distillation on single images
blocks.zh: 3.2 第2阶段:在单一图像上的交叉视图自我消化

blocks.en:
Stage 2 refines the shared representation through cross-view self-distillation ( Fig. 2 , bottom).
From an augmented crop, the student predicts the tokens produced by a frozen Stage 1 teacher for a clean crop of the same image.
Known crop geometry specifies the target locations, and supervision focuses on the overlap between views.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段通过交叉视图自我消化(图2,底部)来完善共享代表.
从增殖的作物中,该学生预测一个冰冻的第一阶段教师为同样形象的清洁作物而生产的标志物.
已知的作物几何指定了目标位置,监督的重点是观点之间的重叠.

blocks.en:
Both the frozen teacher and the trainable student are initialized from the Stage 1 encoder, and only the student encoder and predictor are updated.
Before training, we compute fixed per-channel statistics to standardize the teacher tokens throughout this stage.
For each image, we independently sample two views: the teacher receives a clean crop B B covering 40% to 100% of the image, while the student receives with equal probability a local crop A A (10% to 40%) or a global crop (40% to 100%) with photometric augmentation ( Sec. S1 ).
blocks.zh:
冷冻师生和可训练学生均从第一阶段编码器初始化,只有学生编码器和预测器更新.
在培训之前,我们计算每个渠道的固定统计数据,使整个阶段的教师标志标准化。
对于每个图像,我们独立地抽样了两种观点:教师得到一个BB清洁作物,覆盖图像的40%至100%,而学生得到一个A(10%至40%)当地作物或一个全球作物(40%至100%),并带有光度增强(Sec.S1)的概率相等。

blocks.en:
Geometry queries specify where and at what scale the predictor should estimate teacher features.
A four-layer transformer predictor P P reads the student tokens E ⁡ ( A ) E(A) and produces one output for each query q i q_{i} associated with patch i i of B B .
In each layer, the queries first attend to one another and then to E ⁡ ( A ) E(A) .
The crop boxes determine the position of each teacher patch center in the coordinate frame of A A .
Each query encodes this position using a fixed sine-cosine embedding, measured in the patch units of A A , and encodes the log side-length ratio of B B to A A through a learned embedding ( Tab. S2 ).
The queries thus supply the geometric correspondence, while the student features provide the visual content used to predict the teacher tokens.

因此,查询提供了几何函证,而学生的特征则提供了用来预测教师符号的视觉内容。

Let V V denote the set of teacher patches whose centers fall inside the student crop A A .
We minimize the mean squared error between the predicted features and the standardized teacher tokens over V V : ℒ 2 = 1 | V | ​ d ​ ∑ i ∈ V ‖ P ⁡ ( E ⁡ ( A ) , q i ) − z ¯ i teacher ​ ( B ) ‖ 2 . \mathcal{L}_{2}=\frac{1}{|V|\,d}\sum_{i\in V}\big\|P\big(E(A),q_{i}\big)-\bar{z}^{\,\text{teacher}}_{i}(B)\big\|^{2}. Unlike masked prediction of unseen regions, this geometry-conditioned objective trains local patch tokens to remain consistent across changes in crop context, scale, and appearance while staying aligned with the frozen Stage 1 teacher.

blocks.en:
Stage 2 trains on 5 million single-image samples drawn from a curated collection of public image-editing datasets ( Sec. S1 ).
These sources provide high-resolution, object-centric scenes well-suited for local cross-view crops, which we sample as individual images without edit-pair or instruction supervision.
After training, we discard the predictor and retain the refined student encoder as ALPS, paired directly with the unchanged Stage 1 text encoder and image projection.
blocks.zh:
第2阶段列车使用500万个单幅图像样本,取材自公共图像编辑数据集(Sec.S1 .)的精选集.
这些来源提供了高分辨率,以物体为中心的场景,非常适合当地的交叉视图作物,我们作为个人图像进行取样,而无需编辑-pair或指令监督.
经过训练后,我们抛弃了预测器,保留了精制学生编码器作为ALPS,直接与不变的第一阶段文本编码器和图像投影成对.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4 评价协议

blocks.en:
We evaluate the encoders across three core capabilities (physical-state information, language alignment, and pixel reconstruction; Sec. 1 ), as well as downstream control, planning, and world-model prediction.
All encoders remain frozen and follow a shared evaluation protocol on each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
我们评价三种核心能力(物理状态信息、语言一致和像素重建;第1节)的编码器,以及下游的控制、规划和世界模型预测。
所有编码器仍被冻结,并遵循每个基准的共同评价协议。

State probe: LIBERO position error relative to ALPS (Stage 1); language: each model’s own text tower. Bold : best ViT-B encoder in each column, ALPS (Stage 1) not ranked; gray : ViT-L references; n/a: no released text tower (not zero).

blocks.en:
We compare fifteen public encoders with our first-stage encoder and ALPS ( Tab. 1 ).
Fourteen of the public models are image encoders, while V-JEPA 2 ViT-L [ 4 ] is a video encoder that takes the last 16 frames at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution and outputs tokens for the current frame.
Our primary comparison uses ViT-B image towers at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution (196 tokens for B/16 and 256 for B/14), taking each encoder’s last-layer patch tokens with its default normalization.
Alongside the ViT-B models, OpenVision 2, V-JEPA 2, and dino.txt [ 32 ] serve as ViT-L references; for dino.txt, we extract the patch tokens after its language-aligned vision head.
blocks.zh:
我们把15个公共编码器与我们的第一阶段编码器和ALPS(表1)进行比较。
14个公共模型是图像编码器,而V-JEPA 2 VIT-L [4]是一个视频编码器,它以256×256256\times 256分辨率和输出符号为当前帧拍摄最后16帧.
我们的主要比较是使用Vit-B图像塔的224×224/224\times 224分辨率(B/16为196令牌,B/14为256令牌),将每个编码器的最后一层补丁令牌与其默认的正常化。
除了Vit-B模型外,OpenVision 2, V-JEPA 2, dino.txt [32] 作为Vit-L的参考;对于dino.txt,我们在其语言相匹配的视觉头之后提取补丁符号.

blocks.en:
The state probe evaluates scene-state readout and action-conditioned prediction directly from frozen tokens ( Fig. 3 ).
Using demonstrations from LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial [ 42 ] , a two-layer attentive probe (2.5M parameters) reads the tokens of the last 16 frames to estimate the movable objects’ 3D positions, orientations, and binary predicates against simulator ground truth.
In the readout setting, the probe estimates the current state from the frames alone; in the two prediction settings, it additionally receives the robot actions over the next 1 or 3 seconds to predict the future state at that horizon.
We report position error relative to our first-stage encoder, averaged across the six combinations of the two suites and three settings ( Tab. S4 reports absolute errors in centimeters).
World models instead predict future tokens in latent space and are evaluated separately ( Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
状态探测器直接从冷冻符(图3)评价场景状态读取和动作条件预测.
利用LIBERO-Object和LIBERO-Spaceal[42]的演示,一个双层的细心探测器(2.5M参数)读取了最后16帧的符号,以估计可移动物体的3D位置,方向,以及二进制前置物与模拟地面真伪的对比.
在读出设置中,探测器仅从帧中估算出当前状态;在两个预测设置中,它额外接收了机器人在接下来的1秒或3秒内的动作,以预测该地平线上的未来状态.
我们报告相对于我们第一阶段编码器的位置错误,平均分为两个套房和三个设置的六个组合(Tab.S4报告厘米的绝对错误).
相反,世界模型预测潜在空间中的未来迹象,并分别加以评价(第5.3节)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate language alignment using each model’s native text tower, reporting ImageNet-1k [ 20 ] zero-shot accuracy and Recall@1 for image-text retrieval on Flickr30k [ 81 ] and COCO [ 41 ] .
For encoders released without a paired text tower, these metrics are marked n/a, indicating the absence of a native text interface rather than a lack of semantic information in the features.
C-RADIOv3 uses the stronger of its two language adaptor heads, while ALPS uses its Stage 1 language interface without modification.
blocks.zh:
我们利用每个模型的原生文本塔来评估语言的校正, 报告ImageNet-1k [20] 0shot精度,
对于没有配对文本塔而发布的编码器,这些度量符被标记为n/a,表明在特征中不存在本土文本界面而非语义信息.
C-RADIOv3使用其两个语言适配器头中较强的,而ALPS则使用其第1阶段语言界面而无需修改.

blocks.en:
To evaluate pixel reconstruction on equal footing, we train a separate lightweight convolutional adapter for each encoder that maps its frozen tokens to the latents of a frozen SDXL autoencoder [ 57 ] for image decoding.
The adapter is trained on 19,000 ImageNet validation images and evaluated on 1,000 held-out images (one per class) using ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error and LPIPS [ 87 ] .
Although much larger generative decoders can reconstruct plausible images from DINOv2 or SigLIP 2 tokens [ 90 ] , our protocol measures the visual detail directly recoverable by a lightweight probe, and ALPS maintains its advantage when paired with a stronger decoder ( Sec. S2 ).
blocks.zh:
为了平等地评估像素重建,我们为每个编码器单独训练一个轻量级的转录器,将它的冷冻信号符映射到一个冷冻的SDXL自动编码器[57]的潜伏处,用于图像解码.
适配器接受了19000张ImageNet验证图像的培训,并使用l 1\ell\%1}错误和LPIPS [87],对1000张被搁置的图像(每班1张)进行了评价.
虽然大得多的基因解码器可以重建来自DINOv2或SigLIP 2令牌的假象[90],但我们的协议测量了可直接通过轻量级探测器回收的视觉细节,而ALPS在配对较强的解码器(Sec. S2)时保持其优势.

blocks.en:
For visuomotor control, we train the LIBERO transformer policy [ 42 ] on frozen visual tokens via behavior cloning with 50 demonstrations per task across four LIBERO suites.
Task instructions are embedded either by a frozen BERT model [ 21 ] or by each encoder’s native text tower.
Each trained policy is evaluated three times over 50 rollouts per task ( Sec. S2 ).
blocks.zh:
对于粘液电动机控制,我们通过行为克隆,对冷冻视觉信号器进行LIBERO变压器政策[42] 的培训,每个任务在4个LIBERO套间进行50个演示.
任务指令由冷冻的BERT模型[21]或每个编码器的本地文本塔嵌入.
每项训练有素的政策都经过三次评价,每次执行50次以上(Sec.S2)。

blocks.en:
We follow the DINO-WM protocol [ 91 ] on PushT, Wall, PointMaze, Granular, and Rope, and LeWorldModel [ 47 ] on Reacher.
On each task, we train an identical dynamics predictor over the frozen patch tokens of each encoder to support both cross-entropy planning and multi-step prediction evaluation ( Sec. S2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们遵循关于PushT,Wall,PointMaze,Granular,和绳索的DINO-WM协议[91]和关于Reacher的LeWorldModel[47].
在每项任务上,我们在每个编码器的冷冻补丁符号上训练一个相同的动态预测器,以支持跨进式规划和多步预测评价(Sec. S2 )。

blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 一个用于状态、语言和像素的编码器

blocks.zh: 表1和(b)将ALPS与15个公共编码器比较,涉及国家信息、语言对齐和像素重建。

blocks.en:
ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate relative position error among the compared ViT-B encoders (.829), followed by C-RADIOv3 (.864) and DINOv3 (.870); together, these three models form a leading group ahead of PE-Spatial (.936).
ALPS also achieves the lowest error in each of the three individual settings (readout, +1 s, and +3 s) as well as on frames rendered at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution ( Tab. S6 ).
While V-JEPA 2-L matches its aggregate error using 3.5 × 3.5\times as many parameters and video pretraining, the two models show complementary strengths: V-JEPA 2 reads out the current state more accurately (.741 vs. .842), whereas ALPS is more accurate at 3-second prediction (.813 vs. .904).
Compared with SigLIP 2 and PE-Core (1.160 and 1.170), ALPS reduces aggregate state-probe error by about 29%, and probing their intermediate layers narrows this gap without closing it ( Sec. S2 ).
On moving objects, ALPS reaches a mean error of 3.22 cm across the four prediction settings, matching the 3.04–3.25 cm range of V-JEPA 2, DINOv3, and C-RADIOv3 ( Tab. S5 ).
blocks.zh:
ALPS在比较的VIT-B编码器(829)中实现了最低的聚合相对位置误差,其次是C-RADIOv3(864)和DINOv3(870);这三种型号一起组成了领先PE-Spatial(936)的领先组.
ALPS在三种单个设置(readout, +1 s, 和+3 s)中,以及在256×256256\times 256分辨率(Tab. S6)渲染的帧上,也实现了最小的误差.
V-JEPA期间 2-L 使用3.5×3.5\时间来匹配其总误差,因为许多参数和视频预训,两种模型显示出互补的优点:V-JEPA 2更准确地读出当前状态(741 vs. 842),而ALPS在3秒预测(813 vs.904)时更准确.
与SigLIP 2和PE-Core(1.160和1.170)相比,ALPS将总的状态探测误差减少约29%,并探测它们的中间层缩小了这个差数而不关闭(Sec. S2).
在移动物体上,ALPS在四个预测设置上达到3.22厘米的平均误差,与V-JEPA 2,DINov3和C-RADIOv3(Tab. S5)的3.04–3.25厘米范围相匹配.

blocks.en:
ALPS retains retrieval performance close to the strongest image-text encoders in our comparison.
It reaches 93.2/78.9 Recall@1 on Flickr30k and 70.2/51.9 on COCO (image-to-text/text-to-image), within 2 points of the best score on each of the four measures.
Its ImageNet zero-shot accuracy is 73.4, compared with 78.4 for PE-Core, the strongest ViT-B image-text encoder on this metric.
This larger 5.0-point gap on classification is expected when pretraining on descriptive synthetic captions, whose distribution differs from short ImageNet class prompts [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
ALPS在比较中保留了接近最强图像文本编码器的检索性能.
它在Flickr30k上的回想起@1和COCO上的回想起70.2/51.9(图像到文本/文本到图像),在四项措施中每一措施的最佳分数的2分之内。
它的ImageNet零镜头精度为73.4,而PE-Core则是这个度量衡上最强的Vit-B图像文本编码器.
在对描述性合成标题进行预训时,预计在分类方面会出现5.0点的较大差距,其分布不同于短的ImageNet类提示[43].

blocks.en:
ALPS preserves fine visual detail that can be decoded directly from its tokens.
With the evaluation decoder, ALPS achieves an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error of .120 and an LPIPS of .372 ( Fig. 4 ), yielding a lower ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error than every compared encoder not explicitly trained to reconstruct pixels or latents.
In particular, C-RADIOv3 has 34% higher ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error (.161), DINOv3 has 63% higher error (.196), and the image-text encoders have more than twice the error.
Encoders pretrained to reconstruct pixels (MAE at .109 and VC-1 at .106) or autoencoder latents (OpenVision 3 at .104) reconstruct more accurately, but incur 14% to 22% higher state-probe error.
LPIPS gives a slightly different ordering: these three reconstruction-focused encoders score .243–.260, and C-RADIOv3 also edges out ALPS (.359, about 4% lower).
Under a stronger decoder configuration, however, ALPS maintains a lower ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error than C-RADIOv3 (.107 vs. .141, about 24% lower) and overtakes it on LPIPS (.302 vs. .311; Tab. S18 ).
blocks.zh:
ALPS保存了精细的视觉细节,可以直接从它的符文中解码.
有了评价解码器,ALPS实现了1 1\ell\1}的差错为.120,LPIPS的差错为372(图4),产生比每个没有经过明确训练来重建像素或潜伏的比较编码器更低的l 1\ell\1}错误.
尤其是,C-RADIOv3有34%的更高l 1\ell\%1}错误(161),DINov3有63%的更高错误(196),图像文本编码器有两倍以上的错误.
编码器预选重建像素(MAE at .109,VC-1 at 1.06)或自动编码器潜伏(OpenVision 3 at 1.04),更准确地重建,但发生14%至22%的州检误差.
LPIPS给出的顺序略有不同:这3个重心重建的编码器得分为243–260,C-RADIOv3也比ALPS(359,低约4 % ) 差.
然而,在更强的解码器配置下,ALPS保持比C-RADIOv3(107 vs.141,约低24%)更低的l 1\ell\1}错误,并在LPIPS(302 vs. 311; Tab. S18)上超过.

blocks.en:
ALPS combines leading state-probe performance, strong language alignment, and accurate pixel reconstruction in one frozen representation.
Other leading state encoders have weaker retrieval or no paired text tower, while encoders with comparable retrieval or lower reconstruction error have higher state-probe error ( ).
We use these interfaces for instruction-conditioned control and visual inspection of predicted world-model rollouts ( Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
ALPS结合了领先的状态-probe性能,强大的语言对齐,以及精确的像素重建在一个被冻结的表示中.
其他主要状态编码器的检索能力较弱或没有配对的文本塔,而具有可比较的检索或较低的重建错误的编码器则有更高的状态-探测错误(.
我们利用这些接口对预测的世界模型推出进行有指导条件的控制和目视检查(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Effect of cross-view refinement on state and language
blocks.zh: 5.2 交叉观点改进对国家和语言的影响

blocks.en:
Cross-view refinement moves our encoder into the leading state group: before refinement, ALPS (Stage 1) has higher state-probe error than seven public ViT-B encoders in Tab. 1 , whereas after refinement it achieves the lowest. Figure 5 compares the same Stage 2 recipe across our first-stage encoder, SigLIP 2-B/16, and CLIP-B/16, each trained for 5 million samples with its own frozen copy as the teacher and evaluated through its unchanged language head ( Tab. S20 ).
For our encoder, refining on DataComp web images also reduces state-probe error, though less than our default curated collection (.886 vs. .829) under the same training budget, reflecting differences in both scene content and native resolution ( Sec. S3 ).

对于我们的编码器,在DataComp网络图像上的精炼也减少了状态检测错误,尽管低于我们在同一培训预算下默认的整理收集(886 vs. 829),反映了场景内容和本土分辨率(sec. S3)的差异.

blocks.en:
Stage 2 reduces our encoder’s aggregate state-probe error by 17% (14% to 19% across the six individual settings) and raises DAVIS video object segmentation from .456 to .533 ( Sec. S2 ).
Similarly, SigLIP 2 improves from 1.160 to .893 on the state probe and from .503 to .552 on DAVIS, while CLIP improves from 1.194 to .898 and from .574 to .585, respectively.

同样,西格利普 2在状态探测器上从1.160改进为8.93,在DAVIS上从503改进为5.52,而CLIP则分别从1.194改进为8.98,从574改进为5.85.

blocks.en:
For ALPS, the improvement in state accuracy comes with minimal change to the other capabilities: image-text retrieval shifts by at most 0.5 points, ImageNet accuracy changes by about 1 point, and reconstruction remains close to its first-stage level ( ℓ 1 \ell_{1} .120 vs. .112 and LPIPS .372 vs. .365).
In contrast, the public encoders lose substantially more language performance.
SigLIP 2 drops by 4.3 points on ImageNet accuracy and by 7.5 and 11.4 points on Flickr30k and COCO image-to-text retrieval, while CLIP drops by 10.2, 10.9, and 11.8 points, respectively.
These results show that cross-view refinement can strengthen state information while preserving the other interfaces, but this balance depends critically on the encoder being refined.
blocks.zh:
对ALPS来说,状态精度的提高随着其他能力的最小变化而出现:图像文本检索转移最多0.5点,ImageNet精度变化约1点,重建仍然接近其第一阶段的水平(l 1\ell%1}.120 vs.112和LPIPS 372 vs.365)。
与之相对的是,公共编码器在语言性能上大为损失.
锡格利普 2在ImageNet精度上下降了4.3分,在Flickr30k和COCO的图像对文本检索上下降了7.5和11.4分,而CLIP则分别下降了10.2,10.9和11.8分.
这些结果表明,交叉视图的改进可以在保留其他接口的同时加强状态信息,但这种平衡在关键上依赖于正在改进的编码器.

blocks.en:
To test whether SigLIP 2 simply requires a smaller step size, we lower its encoder learning rate from 10 − 5 10^{-5} to 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} while keeping all other settings unchanged.
Its state-probe error then falls by 17% (from 1.160 to .959), matching the relative reduction of our encoder (from 1.000 to .829).
Yet it still loses more on every language metric: image-to-text Recall@1 falls by 2.3 points on Flickr30k and 2.9 on COCO, compared with 0.2 and 0.4 for ALPS ( Sec. S5 ).
Under the default refinement schedule, ALPS also exhibits smaller drift in its patch tokens and image embeddings ( Sec. S5 ).
A key structural difference lies in the language readout: ALPS linearly projects mean-pooled patch tokens, whereas SigLIP 2 uses nonlinear attention pooling and CLIP reads a class token.
Because linear projection commutes with average pooling, zero-mean local token updates can cancel out in the pooled image representation, even without an explicit language constraint in Stage 2.
blocks.zh:
为了测试SigLIP 2是否只需要一个较小的阶梯大小,我们将它的编码器学习速率从10 — 5 10 — 5 — 降低到3 — 10 — 6 3 — 6 — 10 — 6 — 5 — ,同时保持所有其他设置不变.
它的状态检测错误随后下降了17%(从1.160降至959),与我们的编码器相对减少(从1.000降至8.29)相匹配.
然而,在每种语言的衡量标准上仍然损失更多:在Flickr30k和COCO上,图像对文本的回顾@1下降了2.3分,而在ALPS(S5 Sec.
根据默认的完善时间表,ALPS还在其补丁符号和图像嵌入物(Sec.S5 )中显示较小的漂移.
一个关键的结构差异在于语言读出:ALPS线性项目平均集合的补丁符号,而SigLIP 2则使用非线性注意力集合,CLIP读取一个类符号.
由于线性投影与平均集合的通勤,0-mean本地令牌更新可以在集合图像代表中取消,即使没有第2阶段中明确的语言限制.

blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 控制、规划和预言

blocks.en:
We next test whether the learned representation supports downstream control, planning, and dynamics prediction.
Policies act directly on the encoded frames, while planners use a world model that predicts future tokens.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们测试所学得的代表性是否支持下游的控制、规划和动态预测。
政策直接在编码框上行动,而规划者则使用预测未来符号的世界模型.

blocks.en:
ALPS achieves the highest mean policy success in our LIBERO evaluation ( Tab. 2 ), which tests four suites using shared BERT instructions in the upper block and each encoder’s native text tower in the lower block.
With BERT, ALPS reaches 83.4% mean success, outperforming spatial encoders such as C-RADIOv3 (78.2%), DINOv2 (78.4%), and DINOv3 (79.0%) as well as SigLIP 2 (81.4%).
Moreover, Stage 2 refinement raises LIBERO-Spatial success by 9.7 points, from 76.8% to 86.5% (per-suite breakdown in Sec. S2 ).
blocks.zh:
ALPS在我们的LIBERO评价(Tab. 2)中实现了最高的中间政策成功,
与BERT相比,ALPS达到83.4%,即成功率高于C-RADIOv3(78.2%)、DINOv2(78.4%)和DINOv3(79.0%)以及SigLIP 2(81.4%)等空间编码器。
此外,第二阶段的改进使LIBERO-SPAC的成功率提高了9.7个百分点,从76.8%提高到86.5%(在S2中每套分类)。

blocks.en:
We replace BERT with projected embeddings from each encoder’s native text tower, scaled to the mean norm of BERT embeddings.
Mean success rises from 83.4% to 85.5% for ALPS, from 81.4% to 84.8% for SigLIP 2, from 78.2% to 81.8% for C-RADIOv3, and from 75.0% to 79.2% for CLIP.
Across three independent training runs per suite, ALPS gains an average of 3.1 percentage points with its native text tower ( Sec. S2 ).
These gains, especially on the multi-step instructions in LIBERO-Long, likely benefit from vision-language alignment during pretraining and, for ALPS, joint training on detailed synthetic captions.
blocks.zh:
我们用每个编码器的原生文本塔的投影嵌入物取代BERT,
ALPS的平均成功率从83.4%上升到85.5%,SigLIP2从81.4%上升到84.8%,C-RADIOv3从78.2%上升到81.8%,CLIP从75.0%上升到79.2%。
在每套独立培训中,ALPS以其原生文字塔(Sec.S2)平均获得3.1个百分点。
这些成果,特别是在LIBERO-Long的多步骤指示方面,可能在预训期间受益于视觉语言的调整,对ALPS来说,则受益于关于详细合成标题的联合培训。

blocks.en:
ALPS leads or ties the best planning results on PushT, Wall, and Granular under the shared training protocols ( Tab. 3 ).
It reaches 90% success on PushT (tied with C-RADIOv3) and 92% on Wall (tied with DINOv2), while all six encoders solve every goal on PointMaze.
On Granular, refinement substantially lowers the Chamfer distance from .324 (Stage 1) to .176, ahead of DINOv3 and SigLIP 2.
On the remaining tasks, C-RADIOv3 achieves the lowest error on Rope (.558 vs. .750), and DINOv3 attains the highest success rate on Reacher (86.0% vs. 78.7%).
blocks.zh:
ALPS在共同培训协议下领导或联系PushT、Wall和Granular的最佳规划结果(表3)。
它在PushT上取得了90%的成功(与C-RADIOv3搭配),在Wall上取得了92%的成功(与DINOv2搭配),而所有6个编码器都解决了PointMaze上的每个进球.
在Granular上,精炼使Chamfer距离从324(第1阶段)大幅降低到176,领先于DINOv3和SigLIP 2. 国家
在剩余任务上,C-RADIOv3在绳索上实现了最小的误差(558 vs.750),DINOv3在Reacher上实现了最高的成功率(86.0% vs 78.7%).

blocks.en:
Refinement also improves the accuracy of predicted states across four tasks ( Tab. 4 ).
We evaluate five-step token predictions using state probes trained on real-frame tokens, with true-token readout as a reference ( Tab. S16 ; protocol and rollout analysis in Sec. S2 ).
Stage 2 reduces the first-stage encoder’s prediction error by 28% on PushT, 17% on Reacher, 13% on Granular, and 11% on Rope.
Compared with specialized spatial encoders, ALPS outperforms DINOv3 on PushT and matches its accuracy on Granular and Rope, while C-RADIOv3 and DINOv3 achieve lower error on Reacher.
On Wall, true-token readout error is already close to prediction error, leaving little room to differentiate the encoders.
blocks.zh:
完善还提高了四个任务的预测状态的准确性(Tab.4 )。
我们利用经过真实框架符号培训的状态探测器来评价五步符号预测,并将真数据读出作为参考(Tab.S16;S2中的协议和推出分析)。
第二阶段将第一阶段编码器的预测误差在PushT上减少28%,在Reacher上减少17%,在Granular上减少13%,在绳索上减少11%。
与专业的空间编码器相比,ALPS在PushT上的DINov3优于其精度,在Granular和Rope上匹配其精度,而C-RADIOv3和DINov3则在Reacher上实现了较低的误差.
在Wall上,真肯读出错误已经接近预测错误,几乎没有空间区分编码器.

The pixel interface makes the world model’s imagined futures visible.
On PushT, an evaluation decoder trained only on real-frame tokens ( Sec. 4 ) renders the world model’s five-step open-loop predictions without participating in dynamics training or planning ( Figs. 6 and S15 ).
The rendered rollouts clearly expose predicted object motion and visual errors, with ALPS achieving lower five-step LPIPS (.020) than DINOv3 (.024), Stage 1 (.025), and SigLIP 2 (.031), behind only C-RADIOv3 (.018).
blocks.zh:
像素界面让世界模型所想象的未来可见.
在PushT上,一个只接受实际框架符号(sec. 4)培训的评价解码器使得世界模型的五步开放式预测没有参与动态培训或规划(图6和S15 ).
所推出的推出显然暴露了预测的物体运动和视觉错误,ALPS的LPIPS(020)比DINOv3(024),第1阶段(025)和SigLIP 2(031)只落后于C-RADIOv3(018).

blocks.en: 5.4 Trade-offs between the first-stage objectives
blocks.zh: 5.4 第一阶段目标之间的权衡

blocks.en:
The first-stage objectives contribute differently to the three capabilities.
We train each variant from scratch at one tenth of the Stage 1 schedule, then apply the same Stage 2 refinement ( Tab. 5 ).
All variants retain contrastive alignment, so the ablation tests the three auxiliary objectives.
The reconstruction loss is essential for the pixel interface: the two variants without it incur 72 % 72\% and 78 % 78\% higher ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reconstruction error after Stage 1 (.194 and .200 vs. .113).
Removing reconstruction or captioning lowers state-probe error by 8.5 % 8.5\% and 4.3 % 4.3\% , respectively, indicating a capacity trade-off among the auxiliary tasks.
Across all variants, Stage 2 reduces state-probe error by 14 % 14\% to 19 % 19\% , largely preserves language performance, and changes ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error by less than 4 % 4\% .
We therefore retain all objectives in the full recipe, trading a small amount of state-probe accuracy for accurate pixel decoding while still outperforming specialized ViT-B spatial encoders at scale ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
第一阶段的目标对这三个能力的贡献不同。
我们在第一阶段时间表的十分之一从零开始训练每个变体,然后采用同样的第二阶段改进方法(附件5)。
所有变体都保留了对比性对齐,因此衰竭测试了三个辅助目标.
重建损失对像素接口至关重要:没有这种损失的两个变体在第一阶段(194和.200 vs.1.13)之后发生72%的重建错误和78%的78%的重建错误。
删除重建或字幕后, 状态- 可能的错误分别降低8.5% 8.5% 4.3% 4.3% , 表明辅助任务之间的能力权衡。
在所有的变体中,第2阶段将状态检测错误减少14% 14 QQ 至19% 19 QQ ,基本上保留了语言性能,并且将l 1\ellQQ1}错误减少不到4% 4 QQ 。
因此,我们保留了全部食谱中的所有目标,用少量的状态检测精度来进行精确的像素解码,同时在规模上仍然比专业的ViT-B空间编码器(Tab. 1)要好。

blocks.en:
Refinement also preserves language alignment even without the three auxiliary objectives.
For the contrastive-only variant, ImageNet zero-shot accuracy changes from 69.8 to 67.9, while image-to-text Recall@1 changes from 91.0 to 89.3 on Flickr30k and from 67.1 to 64.1 on COCO.
Thus, the auxiliary objectives are not required to retain strong language alignment in this reduced-budget setting.
blocks.zh:
完善还保留了语言对齐,即使没有三个辅助目标.
对于只比较的变体,ImageNet的零射精度从69.8发变为67.9发,而图像到文本的Recall@1则从Flickr30k的91.0发改为89.3发,COCO的67.1发改为64.1发.
因此,不要求辅助目标在这种削减预算的情况下保持强有力的语言一致性。

blocks.en:
Dense correspondence directly supervises local patch matching across crops, scales, and flips ( Sec. 3.1 ).
Under the one-tenth budget of Tab. 5 , removing ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} has minimal impact on global and single-view metrics (changing aggregate state-probe error by less than 1 % 1\% , ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error by under .001 .001 , LPIPS negligibly, and retrieval by at most 1.1 points), as these benchmarks do not directly test cross-view patch correspondence.
When evaluated directly on cross-view patch matching ( Sec. S4 ), however, removing ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} reduces matching accuracy by 6.0 points after Stage 1 (from 37.4% to 31.4%), and the full recipe retains a 2.6-point advantage even after Stage 2 refinement (40.8% vs. 38.2%).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
ALPS shows that a single frozen visual representation, pretrained on still images and text, can combine competitive state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction.
Cross-view refinement strengthens state representations while preserving the language and pixel interfaces.
The same tokens support robot control, world-model prediction and planning, and visual inspection of predicted scenes.
These results suggest visual state pretraining as a shared foundation for robot policies and world models.
blocks.zh:
ALPS显示,单一的冷冻视觉表现,在静态图像和文本上预先训练,可以结合竞争性状态信息,本土语言对齐,以及像素重建.
交叉视图的完善在保留语言和像素界面的同时加强了状态表示.
同物支持机器人控制,世界模型预测和规划,以及预测场景的视觉检查.
这些结果表明视觉状态预训是机器人政策和世界模型的共同基础.

blocks.en:
We focus on a ViT-B/16 backbone and simulation benchmarks for controlled comparison across fifteen encoders, leaving larger model scales and real-robot deployment to future work.
On the training side, our recipe relies on a two-stage curriculum to balance reconstruction, language, and spatial state ( Sec. 5.4 ); folding cross-view refinement into a single training stage remains an open question.
Moreover, ALPS is pretrained without video supervision and is less sensitive to fine-grained temporal actions despite improving cross-frame correspondence on DAVIS ( Sec. S2 ), which motivates extending Stage 2 to video and interaction data.
Finally, our downstream evaluations test language-conditioned control and world-model planning in separate settings; integrating state, language, and pixel decoding into a single language-guided, pixel-verifiable planner is a natural next step.
blocks.zh:
我们侧重于Vit-B/16主干线和模拟基准,用于对15个编码器进行有控制的比较,将更大的模型尺度和实际机器人部署留给今后的工作。
在培训方面,我们的食谱依靠两个阶段的课程来平衡重建、语言和空间状态(第5.4节);将交叉视图的改进折叠成单一的培训阶段仍然是一个未决问题。
此外,ALPS在没有视频监督的情况下接受预先培训,尽管改进了DAVIS(Sec.S2)上的跨框架通信,从而促使第二阶段扩大到视频和互动数据,但对精细的时间行动不太敏感。
最后,我们的下游评价在不同的场合测试语言条件的控制和世界模式规划;将状态,语言和像素解码整合到单一语言指导,像素可验证的规划器中是自然的下一步.

blocks.en:
Stage 2 trains on 5M single-image samples drawn from a curated collection of public image-editing datasets ( Tab. S3 ), which provide high-resolution, object-centric scenes.
Dataset metadata and edit pairings are used only for deduplication, filtering, and sampling weights.
Specifically, we remove exact duplicates; global or camera-level edits (style, tone, weather, lighting, background, or viewpoint) and edits of unknown type; image pairs that are identical, misaligned, unchanged, or re-rendered under a patch-wise pixel check at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution; and frames from real videos.
We cap each instruction group at 200 instances and each source image at 4 instances, applying no further filtering on resolution, aesthetics, or content.
During training, attribute-level records are subsampled to 10% of the samples, and physical-state records (relations, states, and poses) are sampled with probability 0.05.
Each training sample selects a record according to these weights and takes either its source or edited image with probability 0.5; both crops A A and B B are extracted from this single image, and neither the edit pairing nor any text instruction is used in the training objective.
Every refinement experiment in this paper uses this exact budget of 5M sampled images (4,883 steps at batch size 1,024).
The collection contains no real video: at most 1.8% of the sampled images are individual frames from a generative video dataset (PICA-100K), and at most 2.5% come from AURORA, which mixes edited photographs with simulator renderings.

Data. We use agent-view camera recordings from the LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial demonstrations (10 tasks with 50 demonstrations each), flipped upright and subsampled from 20 to 10 Hz; frames are stored at 128 × 128 128\times 128 resolution and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 via bicubic interpolation.
For each task, demonstrations are split by episode into 35 for training, 5 for validation, and 5 for testing, while the remaining 5 are held out as a reserve test set unused in this work.
Every frame whose prediction target falls within the same episode serves as a valid sample, yielding roughly 11k–26k training samples and 1.5k–3.7k test samples per setting.

预测目标在同一场次内的每一帧都可作为有效的样本,每次生成约11k-26k培训样本和1.5k-3.7k测试样本。

blocks.en:
Targets. Each movable object in a suite is assigned a fixed slot in alphabetical order: 11 slots in LIBERO-Object (7 present per task) and 5 in LIBERO-Spatial, with absent objects masked out.
From the simulator ground truth, we extract each object’s 3D world-frame position, its orientation (predicted as a 6D rotation representation and evaluated up to object symmetries), and the suite’s 10 binary on and in predicates.
The prediction settings target the scene state 10 or 30 frames ahead while supplying the probe with the 20 or 60 intervening robot actions.

从模拟器的地面真理中,我们提取每个物体的3D世界框架位置,其方向(预设为6D旋转表示并评价为对象对称),套件的10个二进制在上和上方.
预测设置的目标是场景前方的10或30帧,同时为探测器提供20或60个介入的机器人动作.

blocks.en:
Probe. Patch tokens from the last 16 frames are standardized per channel using statistics computed from every fifth training episode, then projected to width 256 with learned spatial and temporal embeddings; robot actions are embedded via a lightweight MLP.
Eight learned queries pass through two transformer decoder layers (4 heads, feed-forward width 1,024) that cross-attend to all visual and action tokens, followed by linear heads that predict positions, rotations, and predicates.
The training objective sums the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} position loss, 0.1 × 0.1\times the rotation loss, and the binary cross-entropy predicate loss.
We train the probe using AdamW (learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.01, cosine schedule without warm-up, gradient clipping at 1.0) for 6,000 steps with batch size 128 and bfloat16 mixed precision, evaluating validation loss every 1,000 steps and selecting the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss.
We report mean Euclidean position error across all test samples and present objects.
Two simple baselines contextualize these errors: predicting each object’s mean training position yields 9.6 to 16.1 cm error across the six settings, whereas copying the true current position yields 1.5 to 4.8 cm overall at +1 and +3 s (since most objects remain static) but 12.8 to 31.6 cm on moving objects, where all tested encoders achieve under 6 cm ( Tab. S5 ).

blocks.en:
Encoders. Each encoder uses its default input normalization; replacing DINOv2’s native normalization with the DINO-WM convention (mean and standard deviation 0.5) lowers its relative error from .942 to .909.
V-JEPA 2 takes 16-frame clips at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, whereas TIPSv2 and PE-Spatial are evaluated at 224 × 224 224\times 224 rather than their native 448 and 512 resolutions.
For MAE (the pretrained ViT-B/16 without fine-tuning), VC-1 (the base release), and PE-Spatial, we extract patch tokens after the final normalization layer.
For dino.txt, both the state probe and evaluation decoder read the patch tokens after its vision head (256 tokens of width 1,024), while language tasks use its default image representation (the class token concatenated with the mean-pooled patch token after the vision head), tokenizer, and preprocessing.
Using the tokens after its vision head, dino.txt yields the highest state-probe error in our comparison (1.226); extracting tokens directly from its frozen DINOv2 ViT-L backbone (which lacks language alignment) lowers the error to .924, matching DINOv2 ViT-B (.942).

Standard LIBERO demonstrations store frames at 128 × 128 128\times 128 resolution, which are upsampled to each encoder’s input size.
To verify that our findings are not an artifact of low-resolution storage, we re-render the camera frames of all episodes directly at 256 × 256 256\times 256 from the recorded simulator states and repeat the state-probe evaluation across all encoders in Tab. 1 ( Tab. S6 ), resizing from 256 pixels to each encoder’s standard input resolution.
At 128 × 128 128\times 128 , re-rendering matches the stored dataset frames within a mean absolute difference of 3.2 out of 255 gray levels.
Higher native resolution reduces position error across all models, and ALPS again achieves the lowest mean relative error among ViT-B encoders (.845), followed by DINOv3 (.862) and C-RADIOv3 (.895), while V-JEPA 2 ViT-L reaches .856.
CLIP, SigLIP 2, PE-Core, OpenVision 3, dino.txt, and MAE benefit the most from higher resolution (e.g., SigLIP 2 improves from 1.160 to 1.066 and PE-Core from 1.170 to 1.078, relative to our first-stage encoder on the same frames), yet still trail the leading spatial encoders.
blocks.zh:

为了证实我们的发现不是低分辨率存储的文物,我们以256×256256\times 256从录制的模拟状态直接将所有事件的相机帧重放,并在Tab. 1(Tab. S6)的所有编码器上重复进行状态检测评价,从256像素调整到每个编码器的标准输入分辨率.
在128 × 128 128\times 128中,在255个灰度中的平均绝对差3.2的范围内,重报匹配存储数据集帧.
较高的原生分辨率可以减少所有模型中的位置误差,ALPS在ViT-B编码器中再次实现最小的平均值相对误差(845),其次是DINOv3(862)和C-RADIOv3(895),而V-JEPA 2 ViT-L则达到8.56.
CLIP,SigLIP 2,PE-Core,OpenVision 3,dino.txt,和MAE从更高的分辨率中获益最大(例如,SigLIP 2从1.160改进到1.066,PE-Core从1.170改进到1.078,相对于我们在同一帧上的第一阶段编码器),但仍然跟随领先的空间编码器.

Because image-text encoders often retain stronger spatial structure in intermediate layers than in their final output [ 7 ] , evaluating only the last layer in Tab. 1 could understate their spatial capability.
We therefore probed blocks 6, 8, and 10 (out of 12, taking unnormalized block outputs) for SigLIP 2 and PE-Core using the same protocol, selecting for each encoder the block with the lowest mean validation loss across the six settings according to a pre-specified rule.
Both encoders select block 6 ( Tab. S7 ), lowering aggregate relative error to 1.147 for SigLIP 2 and 1.009 for PE-Core, compared with 1.160 and 1.170 at the final block; even against their best validation layer, the last layer of ALPS reduces error by 28% and 18%, respectively.
No probed intermediate layer of either model matches ALPS; the lowest test error across all probed blocks (.985 at block 8 of PE-Core) still exceeds that of ALPS (.829).
blocks.zh:
因为图像文本编码器经常在中间层中保留比最终输出[7]更强大的空间结构,只评价Tab中的最后一层. 1可能低估其空间能力。
因此,我们对SigLIP 2和PE-Core使用同一协议的区块6、8和10(在12个区块中,采用非正常的区块输出)进行了探测,根据预先规定的规则,为每个区块选择最低平均验证损失的区块。
两个编码器都选择了区块6(Tab.S7),将SigLIP 2和PE-Core的相对总误差分别降低到1.147和1.009,而最终区块的相对误差分别为1.160和1.170;即使对照其最好的验证层,ALPS的最后一层也分别减少了28%和18%.
两个模型的探测中间层都没有与ALPS匹配;在所有被探测的区块(PE-Core第8区块为985)中,试验最低的误差仍然超过ALPS(829).

Simulator camera images are stored upside down and flipped upright prior to encoding.
Each success rate in Tab. 2 is the mean across three evaluation seeds of a trained policy (50 rollouts per task per evaluation); Tab. S8 reports 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over tasks and initial states, and Tab. S9 provides per-task success rates for the BERT-conditioned policies.
These intervals capture evaluation variance for fixed policy checkpoints across 4,000 bootstrap resamples of tasks and initial states; variance across independent policy trainings is analyzed below.
With BERT instructions, ALPS achieves 85.1% on LIBERO-Goal and 86.5% on LIBERO-Spatial, outperforming all five public baselines on both suites (72.7%–79.9% on Goal and 74.9%–84.1% on Spatial).
On LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Long, ALPS reaches 92.2% and 69.7%, performing on par with SigLIP 2, DINOv2, DINOv3, and C-RADIOv3 (88.1%–94.4% on Object and 66.0%–72.3% on Long), whereas CLIP reaches 93.2% on Object but drops to 56.3% on Long.
Notably, our first-stage encoder already reaches 84.3% on Goal.
Under BERT conditioning, the worst-case single-task success rate of ALPS is 71% on Goal and 73% on Spatial, compared with at most 63% and 62% for the public encoders, and 79% on Object (where DINOv3 reaches 89%). Figure S1 visualizes policy rollouts on two tasks per suite.

blocks.en:
The upper block of Tab. 2 embeds task instructions using a frozen BERT model.
To evaluate a self-contained visual-language system, we replaced BERT with the projected text embeddings from our native text tower (rescaled by a single global scalar so that their mean norm across the 40 instructions matches that of BERT) and retrained the policies with all other settings unchanged.
To account for training stochasticity, we ran three independent training seeds per suite for each text embedding and evaluated every resulting policy three times as in Tab. 2 .
Averaged across the four suites and three training seeds, our native text tower achieves 85.2% success versus 82.1% with BERT, a paired improvement of 3.1 percentage points; hierarchical bootstrapping over training runs, tasks, and rollouts yields a 95% confidence interval of [ − 0.9 , + 7.1 ] [-0.9,+7.1] points, showing that our native text tower serves as an effective instruction interface without an external BERT model.
The lower block of Tab. 2 (and the indented rows of Tab. S8 ) applies the same native-text replacement to each baseline that provides a text tower, keeping all training hyperparameters matched to its BERT counterpart; for ALPS, these entries correspond to the first seed of the three runs above.
SigLIP 2 and CLIP use their own text towers, while C-RADIOv3 uses the text tower of the DFN CLIP ViT-H/14 teacher to which its language adaptor is aligned (matching its language interface in Tab. 1 ); in each case, the projected text embeddings are globally scaled to match the mean BERT norm across the 40 instructions.
As with ALPS, we compare the two instruction interfaces for each encoder via their mean success across the four suites.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 2的上方块采用冷冻的BERT模型嵌入任务指令.
为了评估一个自成一体的视觉语言系统,我们用我们本土的文本塔内嵌的预测文本取代了BERT(用一个单一的全局标尺来缩放,使其在40个指令中的平均值与BERT的规范相匹配),并用所有其他设置来重新训练政策.
为了说明培训的花样,我们每套装有3个独立培训种子,每个文本嵌入,并比Tab的每套政策评价三次。 2 (英语).
平均在四个套间和三个培训种子中,我们本地的文本塔取得了85.2%的成功,而BERT则取得了82.1%的成功,对齐提高了3.1个百分点;在培训跑步、任务和推展上采取阶梯式的夹脚动作,产生了95%的置信间隔[−0.9,+7.1][-0.9,+7.1]点,表明我们的本地文本塔在没有外部的BERT模型的情况下成为有效的教学界面。
Tab. 2的下方块(和Tab. S8的缩进行)对每个提供文本塔的基线采用相同的本土文本替换,保持所有训练超参数与其BERT对等;对ALPS来说,这些条目对应的是上面三个运行的第一个种子.
锡格利普 2和CLIP使用自己的文本塔,而C-RADIOv3则使用其语言适配器与之对齐的DFN CLIP ViT-H/14老师的文本塔(在Tab. 1中匹配其语言界面);在每一种情况下,预测的文本嵌入都在全球范围内进行缩放,以与40个指令的平均值BERT规范相匹配.
同ALPS一样,我们通过四个套房的平均成功来比较每个编码器的两个指令界面。

blocks.en:
World models. For PushT, Wall, PointMaze, Rope, and Granular, we adopt the codebase, datasets, and planner of DINO-WM [ 91 ] .
Each encoder is kept frozen, and its patch tokens are standardized per channel using training-set statistics.
The dynamics predictor is a 6-layer transformer that maps input tokens to predicted future tokens via learned linear projections, without training an image decoder.
All world models share a unified training recipe: batch size 256, learning rate 1.41 × 10 − 3 1.41\times 10^{-3} (scaled by 256 / 32 \sqrt{256/32} from DINO-WM’s base rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} at batch size 32), 200 warm-up steps, cosine decay to 1% of the peak rate, and a constant 1% floor over the final 5% of training.
Total training updates scale with dataset size: 31,000 steps on PushT (roughly four passes over its training windows), 15,500 on Wall and PointMaze, and 7,750 on Rope and Granular.
Conditioning history consists of 3 frames with frame skip 5 on PushT and PointMaze, 1 frame with frame skip 5 on Wall, and 1 frame without frame skip on Rope and Granular.
Following DINO-WM, the predictor operates on a 14 × 14 14\times 14 token grid, so input resolution scales with patch size: 224 × 224 224\times 224 for patch size 16 and 196 × 196 196\times 196 for patch size 14 (DINOv2).
Every encoder thus produces exactly 196 patch tokens per frame across all five tasks.
blocks.zh:
世界模特. 对于PushT,Wall,PointMaze,绳索和Granular,我们采用DINO-WM的代码库,数据集和规划师[91].
每个编码器被冻结,其补丁符号通过培训数据集统计,在每个频道实现标准化.
动态预测器是一个6层的变压器,它通过学习的线性预测将输入符以预测未来符,而不训练图像解码器.
所有世界模式都有一个统一的训练食谱:批量大小256,学习率1.41×10−31.41\time 10×3}(从DINO-WM的基数5×10×4 5\time 10×4}在批量大小32,热身步200,余弦衰减到峰值速率的1%,在最后5%的训练中固定为1%.
以数据集大小更新的培训总规模:PushT上的31 000步(大约4步通过培训窗口),Wall和PointMaze上的15 500步,以及Roope和Granular上的7 750步。
条件历史包括3个帧在PushT和PointMaze上跳过5个帧,1个帧在Wall上跳过5个帧,1个没有帧在Rope和Granular上跳过.
继DINO-WM之后,预测器运行在14×14 14\时的14个令牌网格上,因此输入分辨率尺度的补丁尺寸:224×224\时的补丁尺寸为16个,196×196\时的补丁尺寸为14个(DINOv2).
因此,每个编码器在所有五项任务中每个帧都产生196个补丁符号。

blocks.en:
Planning and evaluation. All five tasks use the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) with 300 candidate sequences and 30 elites over a horizon of 5 world-model steps (30 optimization iterations on PushT and 10 on the remaining tasks), replanning after each execution round.
On PushT, one world-model step corresponds to 5 simulator steps; after executing the 25 planned simulator steps in a round, the planner replans from the newly reached state for up to 10 rounds.
A PushT goal is counted as reached when the combined agent and block position error falls below 20 units (in a 512 × 512 512\times 512 workspace) and the block orientation error is under 20 degrees.
PushT and Wall are evaluated across 50 goals, with Wall success defined as reaching within 4.5 units of the goal position.
PointMaze is evaluated on 50 random start-goal pairs, with success defined as reaching within 0.5 units of the target.
Following DINO-WM, Granular is evaluated on 10 instances and Rope on 50 instances using the Chamfer distance between final and goal particle states (where the first 10 Rope instances match DINO-WM’s default evaluation seed).
Goal states are generated by rotating the initial rope by up to 90 degrees with translation, or by scaling the initial particle pile by a factor of 0.6–0.9 with translation.
Neither task defines an early-stopping success threshold, so planning always executes all 10 rounds.
All encoders are evaluated on identical goals using the same planner seed. Figure S2 illustrates planning results on PushT, and Fig. S3 shows the corresponding rollout trajectories.
blocks.zh:
规划和评价。 所有五个任务都使用交叉进取法(CEM),有300个候选序列和30个精英在5个世界模范步骤的视野(PushT上30个优化迭代,其余任务10个),在每个执行回合后重新规划.
在PushT上,一个世界模型步骤对应5个模拟步骤;在一轮中执行25个计划中的模拟步骤后,计划者从新到达的状态进行重新规划,最多10轮.
一个推 T目标被计算为在组合代理和块位置误差低于20个单位(在512×512 512\times 512工作空间),块方向误差低于20度时达到.
对PushT和Wall的评价涉及50个目标,Wall的成功被定义为在目标位置的4.5个单位内达到.
点马泽按50个随机启动目标对评价,成功的定义是达到目标0.5个单位之内。
在DINO-WM之后,Granular在10个实例上得到评价,在50个实例上使用最终粒子和目标粒子之间的Chamfer距离来评价绳索(其中前10个实例与DINO-WM的默认评价种子相吻合)。
目标状态是通过用翻译旋转初始绳子90度,或用翻译将初始粒子堆积放大0.6-0.9倍而产生。
两个任务都没有定义一个早期停止成功门槛,因此规划总是执行所有十轮.
所有编码器都使用相同的规划者种子在相同目标上进行评估. 图S2说明了PushT的规划结果,图S3显示了相应的推出轨迹.

Because the public DINO-WM release does not include Reacher, we adopt the environment, dataset, and evaluation protocol of LeWorldModel [ 47 ] : 10,000 episodes of 201 frames, goals sampled 25 steps ahead within recorded episodes, an interaction budget of 50 environment steps, and success defined as bringing both joints within 0.05 radians of the target.
Planning uses CEM with 300 samples, 30 elites, and 30 iterations over a 5-step horizon.
We use LeWorldModel’s frozen-encoder baseline architecture, a 6-layer causal transformer predictor without proprioceptive inputs, trained under our unified schedule for 26,000 steps (roughly four passes over the training clips, compared with ten in the default schedule) using mixed precision and unscaled gradient clipping at 1.0.
A random policy succeeds on 6% of the 50 evaluation episodes. Table 3 reports mean success across three planner seeds (42, 43, and 44) on the same 50 episodes, with per-seed results listed in Tab. S12 .
As in the DINO-WM tasks, every encoder outputs 196 tokens (with DINOv2 taking 196 × 196 196\times 196 inputs); following the LeWorldModel baseline, tokens on Reacher are additionally ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized prior to per-channel standardization (computed over 4,096 training frames), and encoder inference runs in float32.

Prediction accuracy. We also evaluate open-loop state prediction accuracy for the trained world models of Tab. 3 across PushT, Wall, Granular, Rope, and Reacher, directly testing learned latent dynamics rather than the upstream encoder tokens probed in Tab. 1 .
For each encoder and task, we train a state probe on real frozen tokens from the training set and freeze it; given a single frame’s tokens, the probe estimates the block pose on PushT, the agent position on Wall, 256 particle coordinates on Granular and Rope, or the two joint angles on Reacher ( Tab. S13 ).
We then apply this frozen probe to tokens predicted 1 to 5 world-model steps ahead from real history frames and recorded actions (corresponding to 5–25 simulator steps on PushT, Wall, and Reacher with frame skip 5, and 1–5 steps on Rope and Granular without frame skip) across 1,500–2,000 held-out windows (100 newly collected episodes on Reacher). Table 4 in the main text reports the 5-step prediction error, while Tab. S16 provides errors at all horizons alongside two baselines: probing the true future tokens at step 5 (which measures the probe’s readout ceiling and serves as a reference rather than a strict lower bound) and copying the last observed frame’s tokens.
Across tasks, ALPS achieves lower 5-step prediction error than both SigLIP 2 and our first-stage encoder on PushT, Granular, Rope, and Reacher, and outperforms DINOv3 on PushT while matching it on Granular and Rope, whereas C-RADIOv3 and DINOv3 attain lower error on Reacher.
Thus, tokens that yield the lowest single-frame readout error are not always the most predictable under learned dynamics.
On Wall, probing true future tokens 5 steps ahead already incurs an error of 9.7–9.8 (matching the error on predicted tokens), so this task does not meaningfully separate the encoders.

Inputs to the world model and state probe. On the four DINO-WM tasks, each history token concatenates the 768 standardized visual channels from the frozen encoder with a 10-dimensional proprioceptive embedding and an action embedding; on Reacher, tokens concatenate only the action embedding ( Tab. S13 ).
During open-loop rollouts, each predicted frame is fed back as history along with its predicted proprioceptive channels on the DINO-WM tasks, while the action channels are populated with the ground-truth recorded actions (as analyzed in Tab. S17 ).
The state probe itself reads only the 768 visual channels of the 196 tokens from a single frame (excluding all proprioceptive and action channels), so both real and predicted visual tokens reside in the same standardized space and are evaluated by the exact same probe.
Because this token space depends only on the frozen encoder and its training-set statistics, a single trained probe per encoder and task evaluates all world-model variants of that encoder.

blocks.en:
Readout, one-step prediction, and rollout. To disentangle token readout error, single-step dynamics error, and multi-step compounding error, we evaluate the state probe of Tab. 4 under four conditions across the 200 validation windows of Tab. S15 using the final world-model checkpoints from Tab. 3 ( Tab. S17 ). True future tokens apply the probe directly to the frozen encoder’s tokens of the ground-truth frame k k steps ahead. One-step prediction from true history uses teacher forcing: at each step k k , the predictor receives the ground-truth tokens (including proprioception) of the three preceding frames along with recorded actions to predict step k k , never conditioning on its own prior predictions.
The five-step open-loop rollout matches the protocol of Tab. 4 and Fig. 6 : starting from three observed frames, each predicted frame and its predicted proprioception are fed back autoregressively as history for the next step, using only the recorded actions.
Two additional baselines complete the table: an open-loop rollout where fed-back proprioceptive channels are replaced with ground-truth recorded proprioception, and a static baseline that repeats the last observed frame, confirming that the world models capture nontrivial motion.
At k = 5 k=5 , the error gap between ALPS and C-RADIOv3 remains nearly constant across settings: 0.7 units on true future tokens, 0.7 on one-step predictions, and 0.8 after the five-step rollout (whose confidence interval includes zero). Notably, autoregressive rollout adds only about 3.0 units of error over one-step prediction for both ALPS and C-RADIOv3, compared with 5.7 to 8.9 units for our first-stage encoder, DINOv3, and SigLIP 2.
Rendered pixel predictions follow the same trend across the three conditions (LPIPS of .0068 vs. .0070, .0083 vs. .0077, and .0203 vs. .0176).
Replacing predicted proprioception with ground-truth proprioception during rollout reduces error for C-RADIOv3 but not for ALPS, widening their gap to 1.6 units.
Across the full 1,695 windows of Tab. 4 , the post-rollout gap is larger than the true-token readout gap (1.1 vs. 0.2 units; Tab. S16 ), indicating that the fraction of error attributable to rollout accumulation varies across trajectory samples.

blocks.en: Pipeline calibration. To verify our implementation against prior work, we trained DINOv2-S/14 (the default encoder in DINO-WM) using DINO-WM’s original recipe and training budget; it achieves 94% success on PushT and 92% on Wall across 50 goals, closely matching both the numbers reported in DINO-WM (90% and 96%) and our evaluation of their released checkpoints (92% and 94%).

blocks.en:
The evaluation decoder, trained from scratch on frozen tokens for each encoder and separate from our Stage 1 pretraining decoder, maps patch tokens to the latent space of a frozen SDXL autoencoder [ 57 ] , whose decoder renders the final image. Specifically, it consists of a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to width 512, a transposed convolution upsampling the 14 × 14 14\times 14 token grid to 28 × 28 28\times 28 (bilinearly resizing token grids that differ from 14 × 14 14\times 14 beforehand), five residual blocks, and a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution to the four latent channels.
We train the adapter using AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) for 20k steps at batch size 8, minimizing the sum of latent-space MSE and decoded-image LPIPS while injecting Gaussian noise of random scale into the input tokens. Training uses 19,000 images from the ImageNet-1k validation set (the first 19 sorted files per class), and evaluation uses the 20th file per class (1,000 held-out images), with all images resized to a short side of 224 pixels and center-cropped.
We compute ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reconstruction error on pixel values scaled to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] .
Passing the held-out images directly through the SDXL autoencoder without token compression yields an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error of .071 and an LPIPS of .130 (serving as an upper-bound reference), whereas predicting the mean training image yields .460 and .816. Figure S7 displays reconstructions on a random sample of twelve held-out images across ten encoders, the first three of which appear in Fig. 4 of the main text.
For V-JEPA 2, each static image is duplicated into a two-frame clip.

Stronger decoding and training configuration. As a capacity control, we re-evaluate four encoders using a larger adapter (width 1,024 and ten residual blocks) trained for 60k steps on 49,000 ImageNet validation images (all 49 remaining files per class, keeping the 20th file strictly held out) and tested on the same 1,000 held-out images ( Tab. S18 ).
Because this setting increases adapter width, depth, training steps, and training set size simultaneously, it tests an overall stronger decoding regime rather than model capacity in isolation.
All four encoders improve on both metrics.
On ℓ 1 \ell_{1} error, ALPS improves from .120 to .107 and C-RADIOv3 from .161 to .141, maintaining a consistent relative advantage for ALPS (25% lower error with the standard adapter and 24% lower with the stronger configuration), while DINOv2 and SigLIP 2 remain at roughly twice our error (.218 and .220).
On LPIPS, ALPS moves from 4% behind C-RADIOv3 under the standard adapter (.372 vs. .359) to 3% ahead under the stronger configuration (.302 vs. .311), while DINOv2 and SigLIP 2 reach .423 and .404.

blocks.en:
Because ALPS is pretrained exclusively on static images and text, we evaluate how its spatial representations transfer to video across two complementary benchmarks ( Tab. S19 ): video object segmentation on DAVIS-2017 [ 58 ] via training-free mask propagation ( 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} ), which tests cross-frame spatial correspondence, and action recognition on Something-Something v2 (SSv2) [ 26 ] using an attentive probe trained for 20 epochs on 16-frame clips at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution, which tests fine-grained temporal dynamics.
Stage 2 refinement improves DAVIS 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} from .456 to .533 while leaving SSv2 largely unchanged (56.4 vs. 55.6); static cross-view refinement thus sharpens frame-to-frame spatial correspondence without supplying fine-grained motion features, underscoring why physical-state representation and action classification should be evaluated separately.
Extending cross-view refinement to video clips and interaction trajectories is a natural next step ( Sec. 6 ).

第2阶段的改进改进改进了DAVIS J & F \ mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}从456到533,而SSv2基本上保持不变(56.4 vs 55.6);静态交叉视图的改进从而在不提供细纹运动特征的情况下使帧对帧的空间对应更加清晰,强调了为什么应当分别评价物理状态的表示和行动分类.
将交叉视图改进到视频剪辑和互动轨迹是自然的下一步(第6节)。

blocks.en:
On DAVIS validation videos, we follow the training-free label propagation protocol of DINO [ 13 ] : ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized last-layer patch tokens in each frame are compared against those of the first frame and the preceding seven frames within a 12-token spatial radius, propagating the soft masks of the top five neighbors (temperature 0.1).
Video frames are resized to a short side of 480 pixels (476 for patch size 14), with positional embeddings interpolated to the resulting token grid; for our encoders, which use fixed sine-cosine embeddings, spatial coordinates are rescaled to match the 14 × 14 14\times 14 pretraining range.
V-JEPA 2 processes 16-frame clips up to the current frame (padded at the start by repeating the first frame), from which we extract the final tubelet’s tokens and rescale spatial rotary positions to its 16 × 16 16\times 16 pretraining grid in the same manner.
Without spatial position rescaling, its rotary embeddings extrapolate poorly to 480p inputs, dropping its 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} score from .526 to .347.
On Something-Something v2, V-JEPA 2 reaches 70.3% under the same position rescaling and probe protocol (re-initializing the input projection for its 1,024-dimensional tokens and matching temporal embeddings to its 8 tubelets); because SSv2 is part of V-JEPA 2’s pretraining corpus, this score serves as an in-domain reference rather than an out-of-distribution transfer result.

在DAVIS验证视频上,我们遵循DINO [13]:l 2\ell\\2}的无训练标签传播协议——每个帧中正常的末层补丁符号与第一个帧和前七个帧在一个12位空间半径范围内进行比较,宣传前五个邻居的软面具(温度0.1).
视频帧调整为480像素的短侧(补丁尺寸为14,476),位置嵌入到产生的令牌网格中;对于使用固定正弦嵌入的我们的编码器,空间坐标调整以匹配14×14 14\14的预训范围.
V-JEPA 2 处理16帧剪辑到当前帧(在开始时通过重复第一个帧来添加),我们从中提取最终的管状符号,并以同样的方式将空间旋转位置调整到16×16\16时16分的预训练格网.
不进行空间位置调整,其旋转嵌入的推算差为480p输入,将其J&F\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}的得分从526降至347.
在Something-Something v2上,V-JEPA 2在相同位置的缩放和探针协议下达到70.3%(重新启动其1,024维信号的输入投影,并将其时间嵌入其8个管子);因为SSv2是V-JEPA 2的预训程序的一部分,所以这个分数作为域内参考而不是分配外转移结果.

Language evaluations run public encoders with float16 autocast and our encoders in float32 (since our encoders output unnormalized patch tokens); for SigLIP 2, switching to float32 changes zero-shot accuracy and retrieval by at most 0.06 points.

blocks.en: S3 Stage 2: full comparison and image source
blocks.zh: S3阶段2:完全比较和图像来源

blocks.en:
Table S20 reports the complete state-probe and language-alignment metrics for the refinement comparison in Fig. 5 under a shared budget of 5M sampled images.
For our encoder, Stage 2 boosts LIBERO-Spatial policy success by 9.7 points while preserving performance on Goal ( + 0.8 +0.8 points) and Long ( + 0.8 +0.8 points); for SigLIP 2, refinement shifts policy success by at most 2.1 points across the three suites.
When refining SigLIP 2 and CLIP, both the student and frozen teacher are initialized from the released image tower, prediction targets are taken after the final normalization layer (matching downstream evaluation) and standardized over 32,768 training images, and the language projection head remains frozen.
Downstream, refined SigLIP 2 reaches 79.0% on LIBERO-Goal and 82.4% on Spatial (compared with 85.1% and 86.5% for ALPS), and 74.4% on Long (compared with 69.7%).
Replacing our curated high-resolution image collection in Stage 2 with single web images from DataComp [ 24 ] yields a state-probe error of .886 (vs. .829), DAVIS 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} of .523 (vs. .533), and ImageNet zero-shot accuracy of 73.6 (vs. 73.4); because DataComp images have substantially lower native resolution (39% have a short side below 224 pixels, compared with 512–1,024 pixels for most images in our curated set), this gap reflects both scene composition and source resolution.

对于我们的编码器来说,第二阶段将LIBERO-空间政策的成功提升9.7分,同时保持目标(+0.8+0.8分)和长(+0.8+0.8分)的绩效;对于SigLIP 2,在三个套间最多2.1分的基础上完善转变政策的成功。
在提炼SigLIP 2和CLIP时,学生和冷冻的老师都从释放的图像塔中初始化,在最终正常化层(匹配下游评价)后采取预测目标,并将超过32,768个训练图像标准化,语言投影头仍然冻结.

blocks.en: S4 Details of the first-stage ablation
blocks.zh: S4 第一阶段延期的细节

blocks.en:
Each ablation variant in Tab. 5 is pretrained from scratch for 10% of the Stage 1 schedule (39k steps at 128 × 128 128\times 128 resolution followed by 6.3k steps at 224 × 224 224\times 224 ) and subsequently refined with the full Stage 2 recipe (4.9k steps, 5M sampled images); variants without the captioning loss train the text tower solely via contrastive alignment.
Text-to-image retrieval mirrors the image-to-text trends: after Stage 1, recall is highest for the contrastive-only variant (47.6 on COCO and 74.4 on Flickr30k) and lowest when removing captioning (45.9 and 72.5), while Stage 2 reduces recall by only 0.4–0.8 points on COCO and 1.1–1.5 points on Flickr30k across all variants.
Because all variants retain contrastive alignment, the ablation isolates the three auxiliary objectives at one-tenth pretraining scale: removing captioning or reconstruction lowers state-probe error (by 4.3% and 8.5% after Stage 1, and by 10.4% and 13.4% relative to the full recipe after Stage 2), removing dense correspondence changes state-probe error by less than 1% but degrades cross-view patch matching ( Tab. S21 ), and none of the auxiliary objectives is required to preserve language alignment during Stage 2.

在Tab中,每个衰变. 5为第一阶段时间表的10%(39k步,128×128128时,128分,6.3k步,224×224\224时)从零开始预训,然后用整个第二阶段的食谱(4.9k步,5M样像)进行精炼;没有标题丢失的变体仅通过对比对齐对文本塔进行调试.
文本到图像检索反映了图像到文本的趋势:第一阶段之后,只比较的变体(COCO为47.6,Flickr30k为74.4)的召回率最高,删除标题(45.9和72.5)时的召回率最低,而第二阶段则只减少CO的0.4-0.8分和Flickr30k所有变体的1.1-1.5分。
由于所有变体都保留了对比性对齐,因此衰减以第10个预训尺度隔离了三个辅助目标:去除字幕或重建降低了状态预言错误(第1阶段之后的4.3%和8.5%,与第2阶段之后的完整配方相比的10.4%和13.4%),去除密集的函证改变状态预言错误的1%以下,但降解了交叉视图补丁匹配(Tab. S21),在第2阶段期间不需要任何辅助目标来保留语言对齐.

blocks.en:
Cross-view patch matching. To directly evaluate the correspondence supervised by ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} , we take the 1,000 held-out ImageNet images from our reconstruction benchmark and extract four pairs of square crops from each image’s central square, resizing every crop to 224 × 224 224\times 224 : (1) the full central square paired with a crop covering 50%–100% of its area, randomly flipped with probability 0.5 (matching the view distribution of ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} ); (2) the same setup using smaller crops of 10%–50% area; (3) the first setting with Stage 2 photometric augmentations applied to the crop; and (4) two partially overlapping crops each covering 30%–70% of the central square.
Each patch in the second view whose center falls inside the first view is matched to its nearest neighbor in the first view by cosine similarity of last-layer tokens, and a match is scored as correct if it selects the patch containing the true geometric center. Table S21 reports mean matching accuracy across the four view settings: removing ℒ dense \mathcal{L}_{\text{dense}} reduces accuracy by 6.0 points after Stage 1 (37.4% to 31.4%) and by 2.6 points after Stage 2 (40.8% to 38.2%).

blocks.en: S5 Representation drift under Stage 2
blocks.zh: S5 第二阶段的代表流动情况

blocks.en:
We pass all 5,000 COCO test images through each encoder before and after Stage 2 refinement (using each model’s language-evaluation preprocessing) and measure feature drift both on corresponding last-layer patch tokens and on the global image embeddings produced by the frozen language head (the projected mean token for ALPS, attention pooling for SigLIP 2, and the projected class token for CLIP).
For standardized token comparisons, each channel is standardized using the pre-refinement statistics of the respective encoder.
For our encoder (Stage 1 vs. ALPS), mean cosine similarity before and after refinement is .88 on raw tokens, .84 on standardized tokens, and .96 on global language embeddings, with a linear centered kernel alignment (CKA) [ 34 ] of .83 on patch tokens; by comparison, SigLIP 2 reaches .81, .72, and .84 (linear CKA .74), and CLIP reaches .77, .71, and .83 (linear CKA .59).
Our representation thus drifts less than those of SigLIP 2 and CLIP (particularly in its global language embedding), and as shown in Sec. 5.4 , our linear mean-pooled language interface preserves alignment through refinement even without any single auxiliary objective in Stage 1.
blocks.zh:
我们通过第2阶段完善前后的每个编码器(使用每个模型的语言评估预处理)传递所有5 000个COCO测试图像,并测量相应的末层补丁符号和冰冻语言头所嵌入的全球图像(ALPS的预测平均符号、SigLIP 2的注意力集中和CLIP的预测类符号)上的特性漂移。
为了进行标准化的代号比较,每个通道都使用各编码器的精细前统计进行标准化.
对于我们的编码器(Stage 1 vs. ALPS),在改进前后的平均余弦相似度是:原始符号为.88,标准化符号为.84,全球语言嵌入式为.96,在补丁符号为.83的线性中心内核对齐(CKA)[34];相比之下,SigLIP 2达到.81、72和84(线性CKA.74),CLIP达到.77、71和83(线性CKA.59)。
因此,我们的表述比SigLIP 2和CLIP(特别是其全球语言嵌入)的表述要少,正如第5.4节所示,我们的线性平均集合语言界面通过改进而保持了一致性,即使第一阶段没有任何单一的辅助目标。

blocks.en:
SigLIP 2 with a smaller encoder learning rate. We repeat Stage 2 refinement on SigLIP 2 with the encoder learning rate reduced from 10 − 5 10^{-5} to 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} and all other hyperparameters unchanged.
Its state-probe error improves from 1.160 to .959 and its DAVIS score from .503 to .553, while ImageNet zero-shot accuracy still drops by 1.9 points, image-to-text Recall@1 drops by 2.3 points on Flickr30k and 2.9 on COCO, and text-to-image Recall@1 drops by 1.0 and 0.6 points.
On the COCO test set, this lower-learning-rate variant yields a mean cosine similarity of .88 on raw tokens, .81 on standardized tokens, and .97 on global language embeddings, with a linear CKA of .81.
Notably, although this SigLIP 2 variant retains slightly higher mean image-embedding similarity than ALPS (.97 vs. .96), it still suffers a larger drop in retrieval accuracy.
Maintaining high average cosine similarity is therefore insufficient on its own to prevent language degradation under nonlinear attention pooling or class-token readouts.
Instead, these results suggest that pairing unnormalized patch tokens with a linear mean-pooled language readout provides a more stable interface under local cross-view refinement.

锡格利普 2,编码器学习率较小. 我们重复第二阶段对SigLIP 2的改进,编码器的学习率从10 - 5 10 - 5 下降到3 - 10 - 6 3 - 10 - 6,所有其他超参数不变。
其状态探测误差从1.160升至959,DAVIS得分从503升至553,而ImageNet零射精度仍然下降1.9分,图像到文本回击@1在Flickr30k和COCO上下降2.3分,文本到图像回击@1下降1.0分和0.6分.
在COCO测试集上,这种学习率较低的变体在原始符号上产生平均余弦的相似性为:88,标准化符号为:81,全球语言嵌入值为:97,线性CKA为:81.
值得注意的是,虽然这个SigLIP 2的变体与ALPS(.97 vs.96)相比保留了略高的平均值成像相似性,但检索准确度仍然下降。
因此,维持高均余弦相似性本身不足以防止在非线性注意力集中或类读取下语言退化。
相反,这些结果表明,将非正常的补丁符号与线性平均集合语言读取的配对,在局部交叉视图完善下提供了更稳定的界面.
